name: shop.import/v1
description: An old shop written into this one by an import plugin (SHOP_IMPORT.md): the plugin reads WooCommerce, later Shopify or Wix, and sends the shop's own NEUTRAL records one kind a batch — categories, tags, attributes, products, variants, links, reviews, coupons; the shop writes drafts only, quietly, keyed by where each came from so a batch sent again changes nothing, converts money only at the owner's rate, holds what cannot be published yet, and later publishes the import on the owner's act and takes that act back.

methods.name: settings.answer
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. What the shop would do with an old shop's settings: the money decision (same, adopt, convert, no_prices, or ask when the currencies differ and the owner has not answered), the ECB's rate for the pair, whether the two shops' prices_include_tax differ, this shop's currency and whether it is empty.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act

methods.name: records.put
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. One batch of ONE kind of an old shop's records, an import call: drafts only, no mail, webhook, notice or catalogue event; keyed by source, kind and source id, so a batch sent again answers already (the same record and money), kept (changed here since: never overwritten) or updated. apply false is the preview: nothing is written. Each record's answer names what was made, why it is held, and what it lost.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act

methods.name: records.list
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. What imports brought into the shop, held, paired with the owner's products and converted, with the old prices as they were read, a page at a time.

methods.name: publish.plan
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. What publishing an old shop's import would do now: its counts, its groups (converted products, used once-per-customer codes, SKU pairs, sales starting within 30 days) and the shop's settings it would replace.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act

methods.name: publish.prices
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. A page of the converted products' old and new prices, for the owner to check before the act.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act

methods.name: publish.apply
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. The owner's act, one page at a time under the act's marker: publishes what was public at the old shop and is not held, with the owner's choices; a page asked again changes nothing.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act

methods.name: publish.undo
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Takes an act back, one page at a time, from what each record held before it.
methods.agent_reason: the import plugin's own abilities are the door: they keep the job, preview first and ask the owner before the act
